prerequisites.title: Google Cloud project with OAuth consent screen
prerequisites.detail: Create a project, enable the Gmail API and configure Branding, Audience and Data Access.

steps.title: Create Google Cloud project and enable Gmail API
steps.detail: Sign in, create or reuse a project, enable the Gmail API.
steps.done_when: Gmail API is enabled in the project

steps.title: Choose narrowest scopes
steps.detail: Map agent features to the narrowest Gmail scopes, preferring non-sensitive ones.

steps.title: Get Composio redirect URI
steps.detail: Copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard, or use your own proxy endpoint if the browser must stay on your domain.

steps.title: Configure consent screen and create OAuth client
steps.detail: Set branding and scopes, then create a Web application client with the redirect URI. Save the secret immediately.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create the Gmail auth config via Composio's API using your client ID and secret.
steps.done_when: Auth config exists and a test connection works

steps.title: Verify domain and publish branding
steps.detail: Verify domains in Search Console, then click Verify Branding and Publish branding.

steps.title: Draft scope justifications
steps.detail: Write per-scope justifications explaining why narrower scopes are not enough, within the 1,000-character limit.

steps.title: Record and upload demo video
steps.detail: Show the OAuth grant in English, the client ID in the address bar, and each scope's feature. Upload to YouTube as Unlisted.

steps.title: Submit data access verification
steps.detail: Submit scopes, justifications and video, then answer Trust & Safety emails.

steps.title: Wait for Google review
steps.detail: Check the verification center manually, since rejections may arrive without email.

steps.title: Complete security assessment
steps.detail: Required for restricted scopes when data is stored on or transmitted to servers.

traps.title: Rejections may come without email
traps.detail: One developer got over ten rejections with no emails and had to check the verification center manually.

traps.title: Scope justification limited to 1,000 characters
traps.detail: Reviewers repeatedly rejected justifications and demos, including scope mismatches between console and real API calls.

traps.title: Testing mode caps and expiring tokens
traps.detail: Testing apps are limited to 100 test users and refresh tokens expire after 7 days.

traps.title: No branding edits during verification
traps.detail: Changing branding while verification is in progress requires cancelling it first.

traps.title: Full-access scope is rarely needed
traps.detail: Request https://mail.google.com/ only if you must permanently delete mail; other actions work with narrower scopes.

traps.title: Redirect URI must match exactly
traps.detail: Scheme, case and trailing slash must match the registered URI.

traps.title: Composio callback domain cannot be verified by you
traps.detail: Google verifies redirect-URI domains, and you cannot verify Composio's domain. Route the callback through your own domain with a 302 redirect proxy.

blockers.symptom: Unverified app screen when users connect

blockers.what_to_do: Submit for verification, or add users as test users while developing.

blockers.agent_can_help: Draft an admin instruction note with the client ID.
